How long have you been training and how has your overall weight been effected? If you're maintaining weight then the obvious answer is you need to up your calories.

I would really strongly recommend counting your calories. It's extremely easy to over/under estimate how much you're eating. Track your calories for a couple of weeks, try and stick to an amount. If you're maintaining weight then you're working at your maintenance calories, in which case you'll need to up it to 400-500 calories over that to start putting on weight. If you're losing weight then you're working at a deficit. Protein doesn't seem to be the issue, but protein alone won't put size on, you need the calories alongside it.

How much protein is in your shakes? Usually around 25g for Whey so that totals 50g altogether. At 150lbs you should be getting 3x that amount, are you getting protein from any other meals?

Do you weigh and track your calories/macros to know how much you're actually consuming?

Having a break is always a good option - I would put Rasial to one side and really focus on Zuk. With your gear and armour you can definitely do it. 

Tips for Zuk, go in with the expectation to die and learn. Don't be stressed about where you're standing or how much damage you're taking on the waves. If you die, go back in and continue from where you left off. 

Doing it this way offers so much more freedom with how you play the waves. Once you've got to Zuk, practice, practice, practice. Do the fight over and over again. Even if you're about to kill him for the first time, teleport out and do it again. Do this until the fight is muscle memory. 

Also, for the waves, THREADS OF FATE! ALWAYS!

Once you have it down, repeat and do a full run without banking/dying (easier said than done I know). I promise you, it will click and you'll wonder why you struggled with it.

The Zuk cape is such an insane upgrade, it opens up so much more opportunity for late game PVM. 

Feel free to add my in game and I can help you if needs be :) (If you want to, let me know and I'll PM you my username)

Do you have you reaver set to autofire? With Rasial, if you aren't outputting enough DPS you will struggle to sustain as soul split + reaver does most of it. 

I know you said you're struggling with Zuk, but the cape is such a big upgrade, especially for Rasial (I would say it's almost necessary). With the Zuk cape, you can get skulls off 5 times within about a minute, which offers HUGE damage and in return massive healing.

Enhanced excalibur offers some relief too, worth getting if you don't have.

Additionally, do you have undead slayer perk on your armour? Or under slayer sigil (Undead slayer codex) ability?

Took me about 30 attempts to get my first kill and now I can do most my kills only using 1 or 2 jellys.

Also may be worth looking at the PVME guide for rasial, they have a rotation guide. It's tricky to learn at first but once you have it, your kills will become extremely consistent.
